version.changelog: L7b quality fix - VAGUE_TASK cleared, input/output sections added

llm.summary: The skill is mostly a local cache helper, but it under-discloses callback/network behavior and has overly broad activation guidance for an exec-capable skill.

dimensions.detail: Read, glob, grep, and exec can be proportionate for integrating a cache library into local projects, but they are broad for a documentation-only cache skill and need user-directed use.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation is disclosed as pip install smart-cache. No bundled executable scripts were present in the artifact, but the package provenance and behavior are not defined by this skill artifact.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger condition says to use the skill for data analysis, report generation, statistical insights, and visualization, which is broader than cache management and could route unrelated requests into a skill with read/exec/glob/grep authority.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill documents saving cache data to disk, loading it back, deleting cache entries, and clearing all cache contents. These are cache-relevant but should be confirmed when data may be sensitive or persistent.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is local smart cache management, but the input schema includes callback_url and examples include remote API fetching while the API key section says the skill is pure local and does not involve external API calls.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review this skill before installing. Use it only for explicit cache-management tasks, avoid supplying callback URLs unless you intend to send results to that endpoint, and confirm before running install commands, reading project files into cache, saving cache data to disk, or clearing persistent cache contents.
llm.findings:
[SDI-4] unexpected: Accepted as a material concern: the artifact claims pure local/no external API calls while documenting callback_url and remote API examples.
[SDI-1] unexpected: Accepted: callback_url is not explained as a core cache feature and lacks disclosure of what would be sent externally.
[SQP-1] unexpected: Accepted for the broad trigger at line 213: it covers general data analysis/reporting/visualization rather than cache-specific tasks.
[SQP-1] expected: Downgraded in part: natural-language triggering is common for skills, but the auto-execute wording is a concern when combined with exec and broad triggers.
[SQP-2] expected: Downgraded: delete and clear operations are normal cache-management functions, though users should confirm before clearing persistent or valuable cache data.
[SQP-2] unexpected: Accepted: callback_url creates a possible data-egress path without privacy, destination, or opt-in guidance.
